items.source: Default is true; can be switched to false to optimize runtime performance.
items.translation: 默认值为true；可切换为false以优化运行时性能。

items.source: Note that the override mechanism is not intended as a generic means of inserting crosscutting code: use AOP for that.
items.translation: 注意，重写机制并非用于插入横切代码的通用手段：请使用面向方面编程（AOP）来实现该功能。

items.source: Return the configuration source Object for this metadata element (may be null).
items.translation: 返回此元数据元素的配置源 `Object`（可能为 `null`）。

items.source: Return whether the overridden method is overloaded (i.e., whether argument type matching needs to occur to disambiguate methods of the same name).
items.translation: 返回被重写的方法是否重载（即，是否需要通过参数类型匹配来区分同名方法）。

items.source: Subclasses must override this to indicate whether they match the given method. This allows for argument list checking as well as method name checking.
items.translation: 子类必须重写此方法以指示它们是否匹配给定的方法。这允许进行参数列表检查以及方法名检查。

items.source: Construct a new override for the given method.
items.translation: 为给定方法构建一个新的重写。

items.source: Return the name of the method to be overridden.
items.translation: 返回要重写的方法的名称。

items.source: The exact type of the object will depend on the configuration mechanism used.
items.translation: 对象的精确类型将取决于所使用的配置机制。
